prompt:
Use case: source-matched engineering-paper background restoration
Asset type: one opaque full-canvas background plate for a separately editable industrial-process diagram
Input images: Image 1 is the exact source slide whose background must be preserved.
Primary request: Edit Image 1 to create the blank background plate from the original 16:9 slide.
Scene/backdrop: Preserve only the original warm ivory engineering-paper environment: subtle paper grain, fine pale drafting grid, very faint industrial blueprint sketches at the far left and right edges, the light tiled floor, and its original perspective and horizon. Retain the same overall illumination and nearly white center.
Composition/framing: Keep the entire 1672:941 composition and all background marks in their original positions, scale and perspective. Fill each removed foreground region seamlessly with the surrounding original paper, grid and floor texture.
Constraints: Remove every foreground item from Image 1: all five industrial machines and equipment, all orange and teal illuminated pipes, all arrowheads, all five colored label badges and their lettering, the large Chinese title, subtitle, bottom qualifier and both footer divider lines. The center must be a clean empty engineering room on paper, with no foreground equipment, glow or text. This is background reconstruction from a visual reference, not a claim of pixel-preserving extraction.
Avoid: New machinery, replacement objects, new blueprint drawings, new lines crossing the central field, readable text, labels, arrows, icons, stamps, frame, watermark, flattened/blurred paper, dark floor shadow, changed camera perspective, changed canvas ratio.

input_references.role: exact original concept background and paper texture

review: Accepted after visual inspection. The paper, grid, edge drafting sketches, horizon and floor remain; foreground devices, routes, arrowheads, badges and all text are removed. Opaque RGB plate; reconstructed, not pixel-preserved.
